profile_text.body:
Course Hero is an online learning platform operated as a business of Learneo, Inc. The company describes itself as providing instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep materials, 24/7 homework help, and tutors, with a stated focus on helping students get unstuck during study sessions.

The site's held facts associate Course Hero with QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool categorized under writing and editing, listed at the coursehero.com domain. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
